The operation leverages the 'todo_list_users' database table, specifically utilizing the 'email' and 'password_hash' fields where email uniquely identifies the guest and password_hash is securely stored as a hashed value. Guest accounts are ephemeral and provide limited access, fulfilling the requirements for temporary guest registrations.

The join operation is public and does not require authentication, allowing unauthenticated users to create guest accounts easily. Security is maintained by enforcing password hashing and validation upon creation. This forms the entry point for the guest authentication workflow.

The associated database record uses 'id' as the primary key and timestamps 'created_at' and 'updated_at' for lifecycle management consistent with the schema's fields.

Guests do not have login operations as they do not authenticate with credentials, emphasizing temporary access.

Related operations include the token refresh endpoint which renews guest session tokens, extending guest access seamlessly without requiring re-registration.

Since guests do not have login operations, this refresh operation is their only means of sustaining authentication state.

Security considerations include token integrity and expiration checks to prevent unauthorized access. The operation returns the refreshed tokens in the standard authorization response schema.

This API endpoint completes the authentication flow for guests, working alongside the join operation for account creation.

This operation is the entry point for new users to become authenticated members and is foundational for all subsequent user actions in the Todo list system.

detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides

applications.

ITodoListTask.description:
Represents an individual task in the todo list application managed by authenticated users.

Each task is uniquely identified by a UUID and belongs exclusively to a specific user, ensuring strict ownership and privacy.
The task includes a title, optional description, completion status, and timestamps to track creation, updates, completion, and soft deletion.

This schema ensures accurate representation of the todo_list_tasks table in the Prisma schema.

All foreign key ownership fields are excluded from client input for security; ownership is injected server-side based on the authenticated user context.

This schema is used for detailed task retrieval and update confirmation.

Security: Sensitive fields and user ownership are protected by server-side injection of user context, preventing tampering or impersonation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the todo task, generated by the system at task creation.

title.description: Title of the todo task. Must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 255 characters.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task, limited to 1000 characters.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task, limited to 1000 characters.

is_completed.description: Flag indicating whether the task is completed (true) or still pending (false).

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as completed. Null if task is incomplete.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as completed. Null if task is incomplete.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the task was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last modification to the task.

oneOf.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null indicates the task is currently active.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null indicates the task is currently active.

ITodoListTask.ICreate.description:
Request DTO to create a new todo task.

Includes mandatory title and optional description. The ownership field (todo_list_user_id) is excluded and automatically populated from authentication context. Completion and soft deletion fields are system managed and must not be provided.

Used in task creation API requests to register a new task for the authenticated user.

title.description: Task title. Must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 255 characters.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task. Limited to 1000 characters.

ITodoListTask.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a todo task owned by a specific user. Provides essential task details for list displays and brief overviews.

This summary schema excludes detailed descriptions and timestamps related to task lifecycle management.
It focuses on presenting primary identifiers, completion status, and minimal metadata to optimize listing performance.

All fields are directly mappped to columns in the todo_list_tasks Prisma table excluding sensitive and large textual contents.

This type is typically returned in list API endpoints for tasks.

is_completed.description: Indicates if the task is completed (true) or pending (false).

todo_list_user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the task.

ITodoListUser.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering TodoList users.

This schema is used to specify fields and filters to query the list of registered users in the Todo list application. It supports filtering by email and other common user attributes, along with pagination controls to manage the number of results returned.

page.description: Page number for paginated results submission. Starts from 1, defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of user records to return per page. Typical values range from 10 to 100.

oneOf.description: Generic full-text search string to filter users by email or other key attributes.

search.description: Generic full-text search string to filter users by email or other key attributes.

ITodoListUser.description:
Registered users of the Todo list application who can authenticate and manage their personal tasks.

Each user has a unique email address used for login purposes and a hashed password for secure authentication.
The user entity serves as the authentication principal and owner of tasks and sessions.

Users cannot be deleted outright; soft deletion is not implemented here. User lifecycle primarily includes creation, authentication, and potential deactivation handled outside this schema.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user record as a UUID string.

email.description: Unique email address used for user authentication and communication.

created_at.description: Timestamp string indicating when the user account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp string indicating the last time user account information was updated.

ITodoListUserSession.IRequest.description: Request body schema for searching and filtering todo list user sessions with pagination support.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting from 1

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page

search.description: Search keyword to filter sessions by IP address or URL

filterActive.description: If true, only active sessions are returned

sortBy.description: Field to sort by, such as 'createdAt' or 'ipAddress'

oneOf.description: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending
Sort order: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending

sortOrder.description: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending

ITodoListTask.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating an existing todo list task. This includes modifiable fields such as title, description, completion status, and timestamps for completion and soft deletion.

Ownership and system-managed properties are excluded for security and data consistency reasons.

All fields are optional in update operations to allow partial updates.

This schema enforces secure, validated updates to tasks owned by authenticated users.

title.description: Updated title of the todo task. Must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 255 characters.

oneOf.description: Updated optional detailed description of the todo task, limited to 1000 characters.

description.description: Updated optional detailed description of the todo task, limited to 1000 characters.

is_completed.description: Updated completion status of the task.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the task was marked completed, null if incomplete.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the task was marked completed, null if incomplete.

oneOf.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null indicates the task is active.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null indicates the task is active.

id.description: Unique identifier for each user session record.

todo_list_user_id.description: Identifier of the owning user account associated with this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated, used for auditing and security tracking.

href.description: URL accessed at session initiation, representing the context of session creation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL prior to accessing the session start URL, useful for security and analytics.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp indicating when the session ended or will end.

ITodoListUserSession.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an active or past user authentication session in the Todo list system.

Includes metadata important for session auditing and management without exposing sensitive authentication details.
